target_reference: Frozen external-trained v031-style classifier, evaluated on the same external test matches. Historical BAR-ATH scores are not comparable.
label_policy: External DFL BallStatus and BallPossession are targets only. No BAR-ATH truth is read, used for training, tuning, or model selection. Unknown external ownership is X, never invented.
